error_sampling: All 641 output times including t=0; equal weights over times and sources.
initial_condition: Beta-weighted projection of each Gaussian pressure onto exact modes 0<=m<=20, 0<=l<=16 excluding (0,0), normalized to unit acoustic energy; initial velocity is zero. This finite expansion defines the source, not an approximation claimed to be an unfiltered Gaussian.
field_reference: Continuous beta-weighted L2 pressure error of the piecewise-constant finite-volume reconstruction, including exact subcell projection error. Analytic modal orthogonality supplies the common continuum norm.
receiver_reference: Continuous Gaussian-weighted pressure averages; Gaussian windows normalized on the unit square.
scope: Interface-aligned two-dimensional rigid cavity with a planar impedance jump of eight and equal sound speeds.
